typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Member First Name} as string,
		{Member Middle Initial} as string,
		{Member Last Name} as string,
		{Member Gender} as string,
		{Member Date of Birth} as string,
		{Member Mailing Address1} as string,
		{Member Mailing Address2} as string,
		{Member City} as string,
		{Member State} as string,
		{Member Zip Code} as string,
		{Member Telephone Number} as string,
		{Unique Member ID} as string,
		{Subscriber ID} as string,
		{Product Type} as string,
		{Health Plan Name} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT   [Member First Name] ,[Member Middle Initial] ,[Member Last Name] ,[Member Gender] ,[Member Date of Birth] ,[Member Mailing Address1] ,[Member Mailing Address2] ,[Member City] ,[Member State] ,[Member Zip Code] ,[Member Telephone Number] ,[Unique Member ID] ,[Subscriber ID] ,[Product Type] ,[Health Plan Name] FROM ##GA_P4HB_FINAL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> EXTRACTDATA
EXTRACTDATA select(mapColumn(
		{Member First Name} = {Member First Name},
		{Member Middle Initial} = {Member Middle Initial},
		{Member Last Name} = {Member Last Name},
		{Member Gender} = {Member Gender},
		{Member Date of Birth} = {Member Date of Birth},
		{Member Mailing Address1} = {Member Mailing Address1},
		{Member Mailing Address2} = {Member Mailing Address2},
		{Member City} = {Member City},
		{Member State} = {Member State},
		{Member Zip Code} = {Member Zip Code},
		{Member Telephone Number} = {Member Telephone Number},
		{Unique Member ID} = {Unique Member ID},
		{Subscriber ID} = {Subscriber ID},
		{Product Type} = {Product Type},
		{Health Plan Name} = {Health Plan Name}
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
